title: 午前零時の記憶保管所
author: 渡会 はる

en.title: The Midnight Memory Archive
en.premise: Deep beneath the last stop of a subway line, far removed from the city's hustle and bustle, lies the "Underground Library," where forgotten memories are stored as books. People who have lost loved ones visit this place to retrace the fragmented memories of those who passed away. As the librarian of this institution, a young man spends his days organizing the words left behind. One day, a woman tells him, "Tomorrow, I will forget who I am," and entrusts him with a completely blank book.

zh.title: 午夜零点的记忆保管所
zh.premise: 在远离城市喧嚣的地铁终点站深处，隐藏着一座将被人遗忘的记忆收录为书籍的“地下图书馆”。失去挚 V 的人们为了追寻逝者的点滴记忆，纷纷来到这里。身为该图书馆的管理员，青年每天都在不断整理那些遗留下来的话语。直到某一天，一位声称“明天就会忘记自己”的女性，托付给他一本纯白的书籍。
